# meshmsg v0.1.16

This release adds secure browser downloads for received attachments, makes attachment size limits configurable, and hardens attachment and local IPC behavior.

## Web attachment downloads

- Adds an explicit Download flow for live incoming attachment offers. Files keep their offered names; directory snapshots download as deterministic `.tar` archives.
- Keeps signed offers, blob tickets, and server filesystem paths out of HTTP and the DOM. The bridge uses bounded, expiring opaque IDs and server-selected owner-only temporary paths.
- Requires daemon capability negotiation and strict versioned completion responses; older running daemons leave attachment cards informational.
- Supports retryable and ranged browser transfers with safe `Content-Disposition`, fixed lengths, `Cache-Control: no-store`, and a separate user-clicked **Save file** link.
- Preserves Host/Origin protections, bounds transfer concurrency and IPC lifetime, rejects links/reparse points when opening exports, and safely isolates late daemon exports across web restarts.
- Uses the normal verified daemon download path. Successful web downloads create persistent inbound blob pins, like CLI downloads.

## Attachment limits and reliability

- Adds `meshmsg daemon --max-attachment-bytes <BYTES>` and `MESHMSG_MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES`; the default increases from 1 GiB to 4 GiB and the active limit is reported by daemon status.
- Applies the configured limit to files, directory archives, and downloads, with authoritative size/hash verification.
- Makes attachment admission fail fast when the daemon's two transfer slots are busy instead of queueing indefinitely.
- Pins outgoing blobs durably before attempting to broadcast their offers, and bounds/constrains `offers` listing work and metadata parsing.
- Adds `download --offer-file` as a safer alternative to putting reusable offers in argv.

## IPC and UI hardening

- Strictly validates daemon response types and schema versions with bounded, escaped diagnostics.
- Makes subscription frame reads cancellation-safe and strengthens web feed recovery after disconnects, lag, or peer-directory revision gaps.
- Expands CLI, web, compatibility, malformed-response, restart, range/retry, and real-peer attachment coverage.

Restart running daemons after installation so clients and the web process can negotiate `web_download_v1` and use the configured attachment limit.

Install this exact source release:

```sh
cargo install --git https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg \
  --tag v0.1.16 --locked --force
```

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg/compare/v0.1.15...v0.1.16
